entities.summary: The Cathedral of Saint John the Baptist in Prešov is a Greek Catholic cathedral, the seat of Archbishop of Prešov and the metropolitan church of Slovak Greek Catholic Province. Former eparchy bishops and martyrs Pavol Gojdič and Vasiľ Hopko are buried here. In the temple there also is a copy of Shroud of Turin. Cathedral of Saint John the Baptist is a cathedral in Europe, established in 1500. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
